devdoc.details: Contract for claiming tokens purchased during the presale

ECDSAInvalidSignatureLength(uint256).details: The signature has an invalid length.

ECDSAInvalidSignatureS(bytes32).details: The signature has an S value that is in the upper half order.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

claimTokens(uint256,uint256,uint256,byte.details: Claims tokens based on a signed message

params.signature: Cryptographic signature from the trusted signer

constructor.details: Constructor initializes the contract with the presale manager address

params._presaleManager: Address of the presale manager contract

emergencyPause().details: Pauses the claims functionality in case of an emergency

emergencyUnpause().details: Unpauses the claims functionality in case of an emergency

getUserClaimInfo(address).details: Gets claim information for a user

returns.canClaim: Whether the user can claim tokens
returns.claimed: Amount already claimed by the user

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

recoverERC20(address,uint256,address).details: Allows the owner to recover any ERC20 tokens sent to the contract by mistake

params.recipient: Address to send the tokens to
params.tokenAddress: Address of the token to recover

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

toggleClaims().details: Toggles the claims status Can only be called by the owner after TGE has occurred

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

claimTokens(uint256,uint256,uint256,byte.notice: Signature lifecycles:         - Signatures expire after deadline (MAX_DEADLINE_DURATION = 30 days)         - Each user can only claim once, bounding storage growth         - usedSignatures prevents replay attacks but does not require pruning
